name: Dog House | Papa Burger
description:
Donny Burger x (Papaya x Modified Bananas) Indica | Funk Terpenes: 3.15% Myrcene, Limonene, Caryophyllene

This hybrid from California Seed Bank bears a creamy, tropical flavor profile. Papaya and banana notes are layered over a savory funk. Its dense, frosty buds packed with trichomes give it a potent kick.
